title: Grok Build / Claude plugin manifest
description: Schema for plugin.json, .grok-plugin/plugin.json, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json, checked in that priority order within a plugin root (first found wins); if none is found the plugin still functions via convention-based discovery. Forward-compatible: unknown top-level fields are silently ignored (no deny_unknown_fields), so this schema never restricts additional properties.

name.description: User-facing plugin namespace, kebab-case. Required at the struct level (no serde default). The 1-64-char, lowercase-ascii-alnum-plus-hyphen, no-leading/trailing-hyphen shape is enforced by PluginManifest::validate(), which load_manifest() calls right after parsing -- it is not a raw-deserialization constraint (any non-empty JSON string deserializes fine as "name").

version.description: Semver-style version string; not format-validated by this crate.

keywords.description: Search/discovery keywords; defaults to an empty array.

skills.description: Overrides the default skills/ convention directory; a single path or an array of paths, each resolved relative to the plugin root and rejected (with a warning, not an error) if it escapes the plugin root via '..'.

commands.description: Overrides the default commands/ convention directory; same single-or-multiple-path shape as skills.

agents.description: Overrides the default agents/ convention directory; same single-or-multiple-path shape as skills.

hooks.description: Path to a hooks JSON file, or an inline hooks document (e.g. {"hooks": {...}}), fully supported by the runtime; defaults to hooks/hooks.json at the plugin root when this field is absent.

mcpServers.description: Path to a .mcp.json file, or an inline MCP servers document; the Rust field mcp_servers is renamed to mcpServers by this struct's camelCase rename_all. Defaults to .mcp.json at the plugin root when absent; an inline value does not suppress a sibling .mcp.json file.

lspServers.description: Path to an LSP servers document, or an inline document; the Rust field lsp_servers is renamed to lspServers. Defaults to .lsp.json at the plugin root when absent.

pathOrPaths.description: Untagged PathOrPaths: a JSON string (single path) or an array of JSON strings (multiple paths). Any other shape, or an array containing a non-string element, fails to deserialize because neither enum variant matches.

pathOrInline.description: Untagged PathOrInline: a JSON string is treated as a file path relative to the plugin root; any other JSON value (object, array, number, boolean, or null) is treated as an inline value via serde_json::Value, which accepts literally anything, so this schema places no shape constraint on the non-string case, matching that leniency.
